cmd:
{ systemctl disable --now tg-shadow-scan; echo scan=$(systemctl is-active tg-shadow-scan); P=/opt/trading-bot/positions_regr; : > $P/shadow_in.jsonl; echo 0 > $P/shadow_in.off; echo '{"scan": false}' > $P/shadow_cfg.json; ls -la $P/shadow_in.jsonl $P/shadow_cfg.json | LC_ALL=C cat -v | head -3; python3 -c "
import json,time
d=json.load(open('$P/shadow.json'))
hh=lambda ms: time.strftime('%H:%M:%S',time.gmtime((ms or 0)/1000+7200))
n=0
for i in d['items']:
    if i.get('legacy') or 't0' not in i or i.get('tf')=='5m': continue
    n+=1; p=i.get('p') or {}; o=i.get('o') or {}
    print(i['id'],i.get('var'),i['sym'],i['side'],i['kind'],i['tf'],i['status'],'sig',hh(i['t0']),'in',hh(p.get('t_in')) if p else '-','entry',p.get('entry') or o.get('price'),'stop',p.get('stop0') or o.get('stop'),'tp',p.get('tp') or o.get('tp'),'R',p.get('r_mult'),p.get('reason'),'cf',(i.get('cf') or {}).get('r_mult'))
print('total non-5m',n)
"; } 2>&1 | LC_ALL=C tr -cd '\11\12\40-\176'
